chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q1 Concept Application (3 points) — Set 2: bureaucratic agency power
chunks.content: AP Government FRQ 1, Concept Application, 3 points, one per part A/B/C, scenario-based. Set 2 answer key: A [1] describe the power the bureaucratic agency used in the scenario (e.g., rulemaking/regulatory authority, discretionary implementation of law). B [1] explain how that power operates or affects an outcome in the scenario. C [1] explain how the scenario illustrates a broader course concept (e.g., delegated authority, bureaucratic discretion, checks on the bureaucracy). Same describe/explain/apply task template as Set 1. Common failure: describing what the agency did rather than the power it used; not applying the broader concept to the scenario in C.

chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1A, 3/3
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 3/3 — described the bureaucratic power (A), explained its operation/effect (B), and applied the broader concept to the scenario (C). Full-credit model for Concept Application.

chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1B, 2/3
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 2/3 — earned two parts (typically the describe and one explain) but lost the third, usually the concept-application part C that requires tying the broader concept to the scenario. Illustrates the common Concept Application ceiling.

chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q1 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1C, 1/3
chunks.content: Q1 (Set 2) scored 1/3 — earned only the describe point A, losing both explain parts. Illustrates a response that identifies the agency's power but cannot explain its effect or the broader concept.
